sections.heading: C2 — KG handoff: Preparing Your Vehicle
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG handoff: Preparing Your Vehicle

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
Sit upright with your back on the seat and keep 10 inches between your chest and the steering wheel [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint seat-fit; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-R02, sec07-R03
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Keep the top of the steering wheel at shoulder height or lower and below chin level [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint seat-fit; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-R01, sec07-R03
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A01
Position the headrest so it touches the back of your head above ear level [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint seat-fit; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-R01, sec07-R02
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A01
Frame the rear window with the inside mirror and set the outside mirrors to barely show each side of the vehicle [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint mirrors; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-R01
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A01
Route the lap belt across the hips and the shoulder strap across the shoulder and chest, never under the arm or behind the back [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint belts; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-R06
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A02
Secure every child eight years old or younger in an approved safety seat unless the child is 57 inches tall [A02]
Why it matters: group_hint child-seats; prereq_hint belts; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec07-R07, sec07-R08, sec07-R09
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
Keep a child rear-facing in the back seat until at least two years of age and 30 pounds [A02]
Why it matters: group_hint child-seats; prereq_hint sec07-R06; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-R08
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
Keep a child forward-facing with a harness in the back seat until at least four years of age and 40 pounds [A02]
Why it matters: group_hint child-seats; prereq_hint sec07-R07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-R07, sec07-R09
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Move a child weighing about 40 pounds into a booster seat until the adult belt fits and the child is 57 inches tall [A02]
Why it matters: group_hint child-seats; prereq_hint sec07-R08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-R06, sec07-R08
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A03
Treat an air bag as a high-speed device that works with safety belts, and never place an infant in front of a passenger air bag [A03]
Why it matters: group_hint airbags; prereq_hint belts; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-R05
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0039]
